wpsld: an RO-Crate editor
=========================

This zip runs on any platform with Java 25 or later and JavaFX 27, which it
does not include. Either:

- run it with a JDK that includes JavaFX, such as BellSoft Liberica JDK
  "Full" or Azul Zulu "JDK FX", or
- download the JavaFX 27 SDK for your platform from https://gluonhq.com/products/javafx/
  and copy the files in its lib/ folder (jars and native libraries) into
  this lib/ folder.

Then start bin/wpsld (Linux, macOS) or bin\wpsld.bat (Windows), with
JAVA_HOME set to the JDK or java on the PATH.

The zips for a platform (wpsld-<version>-<platform>.zip) include Java and
JavaFX instead.

Source and licence (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/stain/wpsld
